== Biography ==
Mary was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1675|William Glasgow]] and [[Glendinning-340|Nancy Glendinning]].
<ref name="s">[[Space:A_Brief_Memorial_of_the_Deceased_Members_of_the_Glendinning_Family]]</ref>

The family moved to Ohio, United States.
